_comment: Positions, attributes and weights. See docs/simulation.md §4.2 and §5.

overallWeights._comment: Overall rating = weighted average of attributes. Each position's weights must sum to 1.

carrierWeights._comment: Who has the ball in each zone (relative weights). In the attacking zone the carrier is also the shooter. Attacking was D 15, M 40, S 45 until Task 188b (Tom): midfielders scored as much as strikers and topped the scoring two seasons in three; at S 50, M 35 a striker tops it about two in three (S 49 gave 63%, S 51 73%, S 55 85%).
